verdict.rationale: The evidence describes ELSTER as a hosted online tax office: browser-based with no download or install, running on the tax administration's own servers with a public status page. Nothing documents a self-hostable deployment of the core product. Third-party tax software that transmits through ELSTER, and the ERiC artifact channel, are client-side adjacent channels, not self-hosting the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
